caption: The August 25, 2015 full-frame photograph shows doors marked Entrance at the left, Exit Only doors at the right, and the paving immediately outside. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: Historical view of the museum building, not the separate Welcome Center or a complete parking-to-door route. Door automation, thresholds, clear widths, slopes and current entrance arrangements cannot be established from this photograph.
author: David Dugan

title: Backless bench beside an exhibit (2015)
alt: A wooden backless bench stands on a tiled floor beside a metal rail and large sculpted figures in Creation Museum’s Tower of Babel exhibit area.
caption: The August 25, 2015 view shows a backless bench, tiled floor, exhibit rail and nearby display screen. The rail separates the exhibit from the visitor area; it is not identified as a ramp. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: Historical seating view, not a current rest-point inventory. It does not establish seat height, transfer space, walking distance, a continuous route, lighting levels or current availability. No prominent people are visible.
author: Dsdugan

title: Box Office and Ballroom entrance (2019)
alt: Glass doors below Box Office and Ballroom lettering and a wheelchair symbol at Music Hall face a paved sidewalk with tree grates.
caption: The February 24, 2019 full frame shows the doorway marked 1241, the Box Office/Ballroom sign and nearby paving. A round wall plate is visible beside the central doors; its function is not established by the photograph. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: Historical entrance view, not a current inspection. Threshold height, clear width, door operation, slopes and a complete parking-to-seat route cannot be established. Confirm the current entrance and assistance arrangements.
author: Warren LeMay

title: Steps beside a gated frontage (2019)
alt: Stone steps and a metal handrail lead to wooden Music Hall doors beside a tall closed metal grille and paved sidewalk.
caption: The February 24, 2019 view shows steps at these wooden doors, a handrail and a separate gated opening. It does not show the Box Office doorway pictured separately. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: This historical frontage is not identified as the designated wheelchair entrance. It does not establish current gate operation, an alternative step-free route or stair measurements. Use the linked entrance note and confirm the route with staff.
author: Warren LeMay

title: Stepped viewing equipment in the equatorial room (2020)
alt: A tall wheeled wooden platform with steps and rails, plus a separate stepladder, stands beside a dark telescope support on a wooden floor.
caption: The February 23, 2020 photograph shows stepped equipment in the Cincinnati Observatory equatorial room. The source identifies the room and venue but does not specify which observatory building. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: Historical equipment view, not evidence of current availability, permission to climb, assistance, load limits or a route from an entrance. The Herget building is currently described as closed for renovation; this photo does not establish post-renovation facilities.
author: Warren LeMay

title: Mitchel side ramp and front steps (2020)
alt: A brick path branches toward a black-railed side ramp and a stepped columned entrance at the red-brick Mitchel building.
caption: The February 23, 2020 full frame shows the paved approach, raised side ramp with rails and the separate front steps. The side door itself is not visible. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: Historical photograph, not a current route inspection. It cannot establish ramp gradient, clear width, threshold or door operation, or a continuous parking-to-telescope route. Confirm the current Mitchel arrival arrangements.
author: Warren LeMay

title: Steps to an interior Mitchel doorway (2020)
alt: Wooden steps with rails on both sides lead to a closed wooden door, with small telescopes displayed on either side.
caption: The February 23, 2020 photograph is identified by the source as the O. M. Mitchel Building. It shows the stepped doorway and rails; the source does not identify the room beyond the door. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: Historical interior view. The destination beyond the door, current visitor route, stair dimensions and availability of assistance cannot be established from this image. Do not infer a step-free route to the dome.
author: Warren LeMay

title: Gorge Trail surface and wooded edges (2010)
alt: A granular path curves through woods, with a tree close to the right edge, scattered twigs on the tread and vegetation on both sides.
caption: This July 2010 Gorge Trail view shows one section of granular surface and its wooded edges. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: console0
limitations: Historical view, not a current route inspection. Width, gradient, surface firmness, the complete route and current closures cannot be established. This photograph does not describe the park’s other trails.

title: Plaza steps, paving and seating (2007)
alt: An elevated view of Fountain Square shows wide steps with metal handrails in the foreground, paved plaza areas and groups of tables and chairs around the fountain.
caption: Photographed from the Westin on June 8, 2007, this view shows plaza steps, paving and movable seating, with construction visible beyond the square. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: MamaGeek
limitations: Historical overview with small, distant incidental visitors. It does not establish today’s seating layout, an alternative step-free route, garage elevator operation, door controls or stair measurements. The capture date comes from the photographer’s description; June 14 is the original upload date.

title: Reptile House entrance steps — 2010
alt: Stone steps between low stone walls lead to an open doorway beneath a Reptile House sign, with trees and shrubs beside the approach.
caption: A September 2010 photograph shows steps and the doorway at the Reptile House. Full frame retained from the publisher’s 960-pixel version and converted to WebP.
author: Photo by Greg Hume (Greg5030)
limitations: Historical photograph. It does not establish the entrance used today, another step-free approach, door controls, dimensions or conditions inside. Ask the zoo about the current Reptile House route before relying on this view.

title: Banshee lighting and fog — 2017
alt: The Banshee entrance sign at night, lit blue, purple and yellow above clouds of artificial fog.
caption: An August 2017 night view documents colored lighting and artificial fog around the Banshee entrance sign. Full frame retained; resized by the source and converted to WebP.
limitations: Historical sensory example. A still image cannot establish flashing, sound levels, fog ingredients, exposure or today’s operating effects. It does not show the queue or boarding route. Ask the park about current sensory conditions.
author: Informed Traveler

title: Diamondback entrance and railed queue — 2026
alt: A Diamondback entrance sign spans the foreground, with metal-railed queue paths visible behind it and a few visitors near the lower edge.
caption: A July 2026 view shows the entrance marker and part of Diamondback’s railed queue behind it. Full frame retained; resized by the source and converted to WebP.
limitations: The sign dominates the frame and visitors partly obscure the lower approach. This photo does not establish queue gradient or width, the accommodation entrance, the complete boarding route, transfer assistance or current ride eligibility.
author: DD Lover

title: Crosley Terrace paving and entrance gates — 2025
alt: A broad paved approach between low stone-edged lawns leads toward the Great American Ball Park entrance gates, with baseball-player statues beside the path.
caption: An August 7, 2025 view shows paving joints, low lawn-edge walls and the entrance-gate frontage at Crosley Terrace. Full frame retained from the original photograph and resized to WebP.
author: Gatorfan252525
limitations: Historical approach view. The distant gates do not establish threshold heights, door controls, a wheelchair entry lane, gradient, crowd barriers or the complete route from parking to a seat. The statues are not visitors. Confirm the entrance and current arrangements with the Reds.

title: Seating rows, stair aisles and handrails — 2017
alt: Rows of green stadium seats surround the football field; the foreground aisle descends by steps with metal handrails between seating blocks.
caption: A June 16, 2017 panorama of the stadium then named Paul Brown Stadium shows stepped seating aisles, handrails and tiered seating. Full frame retained and resized to WebP.
author: JonRidinger
limitations: Historical view predating the 2026 renovations and any later seating work. It does not identify accessible seating, elevator routes, wheelchair-space dimensions or the view from a particular reserved seat. Visible stairs are one route, not proof that no alternative exists.

title: West-side seat rows and stair aisles — 2019
alt: Nippert’s red bench rows and upper chairback seats are divided by stair aisles with handrails, below the multi-level west pavilion.
caption: The May 23, 2019 view shows red bench rows, stair aisles with handrails, chairback rows and the multi-level pavilion. It was photographed during the period when FC Cincinnati used Nippert. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
author: Iliketotakevideosoftrains
limitations: Historical seating view. It does not identify a wheelchair bay, companion allocation, entrance, lift or continuous step-free route. Seat configurations, barriers and event arrangements may have changed.

title: Cross-aisle railings and stair openings — 2008
alt: A concrete cross-aisle at Nippert has red metal railings, gaps leading to descending stairs and bench seating above and below.
caption: The June 27, 2008 camera date identifies this historical view of concrete circulation space, red railings and stair openings beside bench seating. Full frame retained; converted to WebP.
author: Greenstrat
limitations: This predates Nippert’s 2015 renovation. The photograph does not establish today’s seating layout, route dimensions, surface condition, wheelchair seating or a continuous entrance-to-seat route. Do not treat the foreground as a verified ramp.

title: Loch Norse bridge and railings — 2008
alt: A plank bridge with black railings crosses Loch Norse toward a paved lakeside path, with NKU’s Fine Arts Center behind it.
caption: The source dates this full-frame view May 31, 2008. It shows the bridge decking, side railings, shadows from overhead beams and part of the lakeside path beside the Fine Arts Center. Converted to WebP without cropping or retouching.
author: Samvscat at English Wikipedia
limitations: Historical outdoor-route context only. This does not identify the current designated accessible entrance or establish a continuous route from parking to the building. Deck condition, gaps, width, slope, thresholds and present-day operation are unverified; do not infer that the bridge is required for arrival.

author: w_lemay
title: Auditorium doorway and stair barrier (2020)
alt: Stone steps with side and center metal handrails rise from the sidewalk to double doors beneath the Auditorium inscription and The Carnegie sign.
caption: A March 2020 photograph shows the auditorium-side stair entrance and handrails. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: This historical view does not show an alternative route, elevator, door controls or the connection from designated parking. It does not establish current entry arrangements, dimensions or operation.

author: w_lemay
title: Front steps, adjacent glass doors and benches (2020)
alt: The Carnegie’s old library facade has a broad stair approach; to the right, benches stand beside glass entrance doors in the adjoining building.
caption: This March 2020 view distinguishes the front library steps from the adjoining glass-door entrance and shows two benches beside the paved forecourt. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
limitations: The lower approach, exact thresholds, door controls and interior connections cannot be confirmed. The photograph does not identify an uninterrupted step-free route, prove which door is used today or verify the Education Center ramp.
